atAGlance: Mì gà is chicken egg-noodle soup, usually with springy mì, chicken, greens, and clear broth.
whatItIs: Mì gà is chicken egg-noodle soup: yellow noodles with chicken, greens, scallions, and a broth that should taste gently of poultry and aromatics.
howToEnjoy: Lift the noodles while they are still springy, then sip the broth before adding chili. A little lime or herbs can brighten the chicken without hiding it.
howLocalsOrder: Order mì gà when you want chicken but prefer chewy egg noodles over rice noodles. Ask for less chili or extra greens before the bowl is finished.
worthKnowing: Mì signals wheat egg noodles on many Vietnamese menus, so mì gà reads differently from phở gà or miến gà even when the protein is the same.
goodToKnow: Ask for no chili if you want Mì gà mild.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì gà.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of chicken egg noodle soup.
